summary_evidence.quote: Current holder keeps title on a tie for its goal. If holder no longer meets goal and several others tie for it, outgoing holder chooses recipient. **Usurper victory has two timing windows:** at the start of an Exile's turn during Wake, or at the end of round 8 under the endgame priority. Losing title prevents this win; retaking resets it to Oathkeeper and restarts the sequence. A title still on Oathkeeper at game end is insufficient.

summary_evidence.quote: 1. **Vow an Oath:** won by Vision alone → next Oath matches that Vision. Any other way or multiple victory methods → choose any Oath **except current one**. Save goal in World Box.

2. **Free Chronicle Citizenship (ignore normal offers):** no Reliquary relic, resource payment or Scepter permission is required. If winner Exile, flip **all** Citizen boards, including boxed, to Exile, then may offer Citizenship to other Exiles except those just flipped. Each accepting Exile must do both: **flip their board to Citizen** and **replace every garrison at each site they rule with exactly one winner-color warband at that site**, regardless of the old garrison size. Winner cannot offer themself Chronicle Citizenship.
